innovation1_problem: How reliably does raw generation follow a trustworthy localized defect condition across RNG while retaining permitted diversity and background?
bootstrapguard_problem: Which generated candidates should be retained under its separately frozen post-generation protocol?

distinction.innovation1_intervention_location: generation process / condition interface, not downstream sample participation
distinction.innovation1_population: all predetermined raw outputs, including failures; no quality-based removal or reroll

forbidden_overlap: discarding low-quality outputs then calling the remainder robust generation
sample ranking/drop/near-zero weighting disguised as training integration
changing cumulative sample exposure or reusing only a successful bank
using a selector score as both generation objective and claimed independent quality evidence

published_pipeline_caution.reason: DefectFill and GAA include selection/filtering stages. Their end-to-end reported gains cannot be attributed to a selector-free generator or transferred to Plastic_Bomo.

possible_thesis_structure_not_an_experim: Contribution 1: a separately justified raw generation-side control/robustness contribution, if its premise and novelty are established
Contribution 2: independent post-generation BootstrapGuard selection contribution under its own qualified protocol
Any later composition study must distinguish generator-only, selector-only and combined effects with disclosed generation/retention/training budgets; a combined win alone proves neither component
